messages:
marta: Heads-up — our APAC GPU Savings Plan coverage drops to ~58% next billing cycle, looks like a ~2-week gap. I ran a quick rollup, we should decide on rotation/convert/sell. :eyes:
eng-infra-bot: Autoscaler pool-asia-west-1 scaled down p4d nodes at 2025-02-15T03:22Z due to low queueing — coverage calc updated.
samir: Can you paste the query and exact instance families? want per-pool utilization numbers.
marta: Sure, quick query I used: ```SELECT region, instance_type, SUM(used_hours) AS used_hours, SUM(covered_hours) AS covered_hours FROM billing.gpu_usage WHERE month='2025-02' GROUP BY 1,2;```
lee: The main offenders are p4d.24xlarge and a mix of older zonal RIs. Majority of unused capacity shows up in asia-west-1 (batch jobs migrated or idle).
olivia: Can we shift batch training back to asia-west to fill gap? any SLA or perf gotchas?
marta: We have ~10 days grace before some of these commitment windows lock. Options: modify scope, sell on marketplace, convert to convertible, or shift workloads. leaning to a combination: route jobs + scope mod.
samir: If we don't act estimated lost realized savings ~ $28k/mo vs current committed baseline. Need procurement decision this week to avoid exposure.
raj: If we add tags/placement hints we can route low-priority batch to asia-west. scheduler change is small — I can get a PR out today for a 20% canary.
marta: @raj add the canary for 20% first. @samir can you check whether modifying scope triggers early termination charges or pro-rated refunds?
billing-bot: SavingsPlan API: some modifications supported with prorated adjustments. See https://billing.cloud/docs/savings-plans#modify — changes are prorated automatically.
samir: Confirmed — modify -> prorated. Marketplace sell: 5% fee + ~30 day listing delay before matched buyer.
lee: Quick note: spinning spot nodes in-region helps keep jobs local but won't increase SavingsPlan coverage (coverage is based on committed usage).
marta: Correct — spots don't count toward reserved coverage but can reduce cross-region job migration needs.
olivia: Convertible RIs could give flexibility, but conversion rules and SKU compatibility are messy. timeline could be longer.
marta: Proposed plan: (A) start routing canary (20%) via @raj, (B) prepare scope modification for clearly underutilized SKUs (samir to draft), (C) list leftovers on marketplace after 2 weeks if still spare.
samir: I'll produce a cost-delta sheet + one-pager for execs. target: decision meeting in 48h.
eng-infra-bot: Created ticket INFRA-4321 "APAC SavingsPlan rotation — canary + scope mod" assigned to @raj @samir @marta.
marta: Thanks — I'll monitor the dashboards and post updates. if anyone has alternate ideas drop them here. /cc @lee @olivia
